column4: cleat#3245 Phase 3 step 2 piece 6a: both tests open a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) (stickyWorkerLeaseTestStore), which skips on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone regardless of what else is set -- workflow_leases is PostgreSQL-only (the issue's own scoping decision, same as pieces 1-5b's tests), so neither has a MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so both skip here. 2 skips, not a subtest group -- same shape as continue-as-new-updates-both-runs-lease-and-payload-rows.tsv's two.
same two tests, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so both skip here too -- see the multi-db/mysql line above.
